story.title: The Secret of the Dream
story.description1: Our master artisans employ the traditional Mochitsuki method—a rhythmic process of pounding steamed rice with heavy wooden mallets. This ancient technique, preserved for generations, is what gives our mochi its signature elastic pull and cloud-like tenderness.
story.description2: Each product is handcrafted within hours of sunrise using only the finest ingredients. Carefully selected to create the perfect balance of flavors.

strawberryDream.name: Strawberry Dream Mochi
strawberryDream.description: Fresh whole strawberry with sweet red bean paste
strawberryDream.longDescription: A cloud-like pillow of premium rice dough infused with natural beet juice, enveloping a whole, sun-ripened strawberry and sweet white bean paste. Our signature seasonal treat.

mangoSunshine.name: Mango Sunshine Mochi
mangoSunshine.description: Alphonso mango nectar with coconut cream
mangoSunshine.longDescription: Tropical paradise in every bite. Made with sweet Alphonso mango purée and creamy coconut filling, wrapped in vibrant orange-tinted mochi. A refreshing summer favorite.

matchaZen.name: Matcha Zen Mochi
matchaZen.description: Premium Uji matcha with sweet red bean
matchaZen.longDescription: Crafted with authentic ceremonial-grade Uji matcha from Kyoto. The earthy, umami-rich green tea flavor pairs perfectly with smooth azuki red bean paste. A traditional Japanese delicacy.

velvetChocolate.name: Velvet Chocolate Mochi
velvetChocolate.longDescription: Indulge in our premium chocolate mochi filled with rich dark cocoa ganache. Made with Belgian chocolate and wrapped in soft, chewy mochi. A perfect balance of bitter and sweet.
